records.issue_text: [BUG] BuildIndex lock scope reduction in bleve.go: removing the top-level cacheMu lock lets concurrent callers for the same NamespacedResource key both construct an index — for on-disk indexes the second fails bleve's file lock and errors out a valid in-flight build; for mem-only indexes the later cache write discards the first index, leaking memory and losing already-fed documents.
records.rationale: In pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve.go, BuildIndex previously took b.cacheMu.Lock() for the entire function (removed in diff) and now only locks around `b.cache[key] = idx`. This change allows concurrent callers for the same `key` to both proceed through `bleve.New(dir, mapper)` / `bleve.NewMemOnly(mapper)` and run the `builder(...)` before either updates the cache, creating a race where (a) two on-disk builds can contend on the same directory, and (b) the later `b.cache[key] = idx` overwrites the earlier index with no cleanup, potentially leaking/losing the first built index state.

records.issue_text: [BUG] NewResourceServer now calls s.Init(ctx) with the caller-supplied constructor context, so the watcher and search background work bind to one constructor-time context — a request-scoped or timeout-scoped context causes the watcher to die on cancellation while the server keeps serving CRUD, silently stopping search index updates.
